profile_text.body:
Hut 8 Corp. is a Miami, Florida based public company, traded under the ticker HUT, that describes itself as owning, operating, and scaling purpose-built businesses which acquire, deploy, and monetize specialized hardware for next-generation, energy-intensive technologies. Through that portfolio, the company says it offers direct exposure to markets created by transformative technologies such as AI and Bitcoin mining.

On the AI side, the company announced the full commercialization of its 1 GW Beacon Point AI Data Center campus with a second 352 MW IT lease, which it says brings campus-level base-term contract value to $19.6 billion. No specific products are tracked for the company, and no MCP servers are recorded.

Among the facts held on the company, Florida is listed as a jurisdiction of litigation exposure with a count of 96, and no individual cases are named. Its SEC filings are identified by CIK 0001964789.
